licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets cover the full distribution: fraudulent acts to obtain licenses or fees; criminal convictions; clinical negligence/incompetence; substance abuse/mental-physical impairment; broad unprofessional/immoral/ethical conduct; aiding unlicensed practice or improper delegation; false advertising; fee splitting, kickbacks, and billing fraud; and violations of statutes, board orders, reporting duties, and administrative requirements.

profession_specific.sedation_anesthesia_.rationale: These buckets map directly onto the clinical sedation depth continuum (minimal → moderate → deep → general anesthesia) plus the two cross-cutting distinctions that appear repeatedly in the data: nitrous oxide/inhalation analgesia as a distinct lightest-level category, pediatric-specific endorsements/permits, and a catch-all for rows that name only a credential type (permit, certificate, registration) or span multiple depth levels without specifying one.
